GETTING STARTED

1. Confirm your email:
https://account.afiax.africa/signup/confirm?token=EXAMPLE

2. Set your password and security key. The page that opens sets up your organisation in a few seconds, then shows a button to do this. You'll sign in to every Oortcloud and Afiax service with this one account (Afiax IAM): a password plus an authenticator app, a passkey or a security key.

3. Invite your team from your Oortcloud portal, when you're ready.

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

Your portal is ready as soon as you confirm. Some services, such as your pharmacy, billing or finance system, take up to half an hour to set up: we'll email you when they're ready.

The trial is free until 19 Dec 2026. Before it ends we'll remind you, and you can pay by M-Pesa or card from the portal. Nothing is charged without a bill you can see first.

NEED HELP?

Email Oortcloud support at support@afiax.africa.

Didn't sign up? Ignore this email: nothing is created until the link is used, and it stops working at 20 Nov 2026, 14:05 EAT.

Sent by Oortcloud, Oort Cloud Computing Limited, the company behind Afiax Connected Healthcare.
Oortcloud will never ask for your password by email or phone.
